Count me in—I’ll select **10 tons this month**. I learned to fish here from my family, and I want the next generation in our village to have that same chance.

Luke, you don’t need to forgo your income to earn our welcome. With all five of us taking 10, we can earn equally and start next month with a full lake. Will you join us at 10 tons and review everyone’s catches together afterward?
